theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] (s t : Finset α) [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α] [Nonempty α] (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s' := s
  let t' := t
  let s_max := s'.sup
  let t_min := t'.inf
  let b := t_min
  use b
  · intro x hx
    have : x ∈ s' := hx
    exact (Finset.Sup_le _ _).mpr (le_refl x)
  · intro y hy
    have : y ∈ t' := hy
    exact (le_Finset.Inf _ _).mpr (le_refl y)
